decisions.reason: The encrypted second channel is central to the strategy of binding mobile communication and a secure identity across channels, so even though it no longer appeared on the website in 2020–2021 it is likely folded into the core platform, and no performance shortfall calls for problemistic search.

Mobile PDF signing supports the stated move toward online contract signing and costs little to maintain alongside the established offer, though its absence from the website suggests weaker salience and some risk of it being absorbed or retired.

The payment compliance suite is peripheral to the core identity offer, its regulatory window has largely passed, and its disappearance from the website signals below-aspiration results, so redirecting its resources to the established business and new ecosystem development is the better use of slack.
